steps.title: Resource markers
steps.content: Colorful circles around verse numbers show that resources are available. Multiple colors mean different tags. Click a verse number to open the Resources panel.

steps.title: Selected verse
steps.content: The top of the panel shows the selected verse or verses. Clicking the reference jumps back to that verse in your Bible.

steps.title: Resource tags
steps.content: When tags are present they appear near the top of the panel. Click a tag to show or hide resources with that tag. Your choices last for this session and update the colors around verse numbers in your Bible.

steps.title: Resource cards
steps.content: Each card is a resource for the selected verse(s). Color swatches show its tags—hover (or long-press on mobile) to see the tag name.

steps.title: Open a page
steps.content: Page numbers show where the selected verse(s) appear in that resource. Click a page number to open the document at that page with the verse highlighted.
